import argparse
import qlib
from qlib.workflow import R
from qlib.workflow.online_manager import OnlineManager
from qlib.workflow.exp import Experiment
from qlib.workflow.task.collect import risk_analysis, backtest
from qlib.workflow.task.utils import get_signals
from qlib.utils import init_instance_by_config
from qlib.workflow.task.utils import reset_report
from qlib.workflow.task.utils import simulate
from qlib.workflow.task.utils import collect_metrics

class RollingOnlineManager:
    def __init__(
        self,
        provider_uri,
        region,
        experiment_name,
        task_url,
        task_db_name,
        task_pool_name,
        rolling_step,
        start_time,
        end_time,
        tasks,
        trainer,
    ):
        self.provider_uri = provider_uri
        self.region = region
        self.experiment_name = experiment_name
        self.task_url = task_url
        self.task_db_name = task_db_name
        self.task_pool_name = task_pool_name
        self.rolling_step = rolling_step
        self.start_time = start_time
        self.end_time = end_time
        self.tasks = tasks
        self.trainer = trainer
        self.exp = None

        qlib.init(provider_uri=self.provider_uri, region=self.region)

    def reset_experiment(self):
        reset_report(self.experiment_name)

    def run_workflow(self):
        self.reset_experiment()
        self.exp = Experiment(self.experiment_name)
        with self.exp:
            # Simulate rolling tasks
            simulate(
                task_url=self.task_url,
                task_db_name=self.task_db_name,
                task_pool_name=self.task_pool_name,
                rolling_step=self.rolling_step,
                start_time=self.start_time,
                end_time=self.end_time,
                tasks=self.tasks,
                trainer=self.trainer,
            )
            # Collect results
            collect_metrics(self.experiment_name)
            # Get signals
            signals = get_signals(self.experiment_name)
            # Backtesting
            backtest_result = backtest(self.experiment_name)
            # Risk analysis
            risk_result = risk_analysis(self.experiment_name)
            return {
                "signals": signals,
                "backtest": backtest_result,
                "risk": risk_result,
            }

    def train_tasks_external(self):
        # This method can be called by other processes/machines for multiprocessing
        OnlineManager(
            task_url=self.task_url,
            task_db_name=self.task_db_name,
            task_pool_name=self.task_pool_name,
            trainer=self.trainer,
        ).run()

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Rolling OnlineManager Simulator")
    parser.add_argument("--provider_uri", type=str, required=True, help="Qlib data provider uri")
    parser.add_argument("--region", type=str, default="cn", help="Market region")
    parser.add_argument("--experiment_name", type=str, required=True, help="Experiment name")
    parser.add_argument("--task_url", type=str, required=True, help="Task URL")
    parser.add_argument("--task_db_name", type=str, required=True, help="Task DB name")
    parser.add_argument("--task_pool_name", type=str, required=True, help="Task pool name")
    parser.add_argument("--rolling_step", type=int, required=True, help="Rolling step")
    parser.add_argument("--start_time", type=str, required=True, help="Start time")
    parser.add_argument("--end_time", type=str, required=True, help="End time")
    parser.add_argument("--tasks", type=str, required=True, help="Tasks config file (python dict string)")
    parser.add_argument("--trainer", type=str, required=True, help="Trainer config file (python dict string)")
    parser.add_argument("--train_external", action="store_true", help="Train tasks externally (multiprocessing)")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    # Convert string dicts to actual dicts
    import ast
    tasks = ast.literal_eval(args.tasks)
    trainer = ast.literal_eval(args.trainer)

    manager = RollingOnlineManager(
        provider_uri=args.provider_uri,
        region=args.region,
        experiment_name=args.experiment_name,
        task_url=args.task_url,
        task_db_name=args.task_db_name,
        task_pool_name=args.task_pool_name,
        rolling_step=args.rolling_step,
        start_time=args.start_time,
        end_time=args.end_time,
        tasks=tasks,
        trainer=trainer,
    )

    if args.train_external:
        manager.train_tasks_external()
    else:
        results = manager.run_workflow()
        print("Signals:", results["signals"])
        print("Backtest:", results["backtest"])
        print("Risk Analysis:", results["risk"])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
